column1: # Cue words for context-cued numbers (languages/cues.py; docs/languages.md); format in
# hu/cues.tsv. Romanian nouns take the article and case endings at the end of the word, so a
# trailing "*" covers "telefon", "telefonul", "telefonului"; forms whose stem changes
# ("comandă" -> "comenzii", "factură" -> "facturii") are listed by stem. Matching ignores case
# and accents, so "ș"/"ş" (comma or cedilla) and a missing diacritic are the same cue.
